author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (admin-config)

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Administrator signed in on the admin documentation lab.
Reviewer-created Matter, Contract, Entity and Knowledge types, Fields, Statuses, an Officer role, a fictional Entity with a current and a resigned Officer, and a fictional Matter.
scenarios.expected: Types, Statuses, Fields and Officer roles can be added, renamed, reordered, edited and archived as the article says. The Slug and a Status's Stage or Category stay fixed. Requiredness blocks creation until the value is supplied. Detach and Archive keep stored values. Archiving an in-use type, Matter Status or Officer role needs a live replacement and moves the records; Restore does not move them back. Protected entries cannot be archived, an in-use Contract Status cannot be archived from the dialog, and narrowing a Global Field attached elsewhere is refused. Non-Administrators cannot open or change the configuration.
scenarios.actual: 13 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3. Add type with Enter, Rename, Edit (description saved on Tab, read-only Slug that kept the original name) and ArrowUp reorder worked on Matter types; Contracts and Entities rows have Edit and Knowledge rows do not. Add field offered Text, Long text, Number, Currency, Date, Boolean, Single select, Multi select, User, Entity; Edit shows no Type control; the Field catalog has no reorder handles. A required attached Field refused Create matter with "Fill <Field>." until a value was chosen. Promote to Global saved; narrowing back was refused with "... is attached outside the matter module — detach it there first, then narrow the scope." until the Contract type attachment was detached. Detach kept the catalog Field; Archive hid the Field while the Matter kept its value; Restore brought it back. Archiving the in-use Matter type with "No reassignment" changed nothing; with a replacement the Matter moved, and Restore left it there. A new Contract Status kept Stage Review after rename, Draft, Active and Expired are locked, and the in-use Internal review dialog said "Move them to another status first." with Archive status disabled. A new Open Matter Status defaulted to group In progress, kept Waiting after rename, and changed group on its row; archiving an in-use Status offered only Open-Category replacements and moved the Matter. An in-use Officer role counted 2 officers (one resigned), Archive role moved both to Director, and Restore left 0 officers on it.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The admin lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Records were named DOC-029 admin-config. Organisation reminder lead times were changed during the run and restored to 30, 14, 7, 1, and On the day; this was confirmed after reload.

Earlier development runs of the same script (logs not kept) failed only on reviewer script errors and left extra DOC-029 admin-config records with other suffixes; walkthrough-r1.json reviewerNotes lists them.
Negative access checks used the seeded Legal Team Member (nadia.haddad) and Business User (jonas.weber), each in its own browser context; roles were confirmed from /api/v1/me.

Not checked in the browser: requiredness when a record changes type, the rule that every Stage or Category keeps a live Status, reopening after a failed multi-part Field save, and the Contract Field AI prompt (covered by configure-analysis).
Archive type with No reassignment on an in-use type left the dialog open with no message; the refusal is silent but nothing changed.
The Officer role check used the Director role as the replacement on a reviewer-created Entity; no seeded Officer was changed.
